items.distractor_fact: Samkvæmt spá Veðurstofunnar frá sama degi í fyrra átti hitinn að mælast {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: According to the national Weather Office's forecast for the same day a year earlier, the temperature was predicted to measure {D}°C.
items.entity_note: The national weather office's year-old forecast archive is a SERIES-type owner (a predicted record, not a measurement), unlike the first sentence's neighboring weather station, a PLACE-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Einkafjárfestir átti á sama tíma hlutabréf í öðru fyrirtæki að verðmæti ${D}.
items.gloss_en: A private investor simultaneously held shares in another company worth ${D}.
items.entity_note: A private investor's personal holding is a PERSON-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other listed company on the same market, an organisation/INSTRUMENT-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Annar vatnshæðarmælir, sem fylgist með affallsskurði svæðisins, mældi vatnsborð upp á {D}m sama mánuð.
items.gloss_en: Another water-level gauge, monitoring the area's drainage canal, measured a water level of {D} m that same month.
items.entity_note: A separate measuring instrument on an unrelated drainage canal is an INSTRUMENT-type owner, unlike the first sentence's neighboring reservoir, a PLACE-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Fjallgöngumaður í sama leiðangri var staddur í {D}m hæð á sama tíma samkvæmt eigin GPS-tæki.
items.gloss_en: A mountaineer in the same expedition was at an altitude of {D} m at the same time, according to his own GPS device.
items.entity_note: A climber's personal GPS reading is a PERSON-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other drone, an INSTRUMENT-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Annar viðskiptavinur sendi þennan sama dag pakka sem vó {D}kg.
items.gloss_en: Another customer sent, on this same day, a package that weighed {D} kg.
items.entity_note: A different customer's unrelated parcel is a PERSON-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other package in the same shipment, a same-kind ENTITY owner.

items.distractor_fact: Í vörulistanum frá því í fyrra var uppgefinn hámarkshraði annarrar vélargerðar {D}km/klst.
items.gloss_en: In last year's catalog, the top speed listed for a different engine model was {D} km/h.
items.entity_note: A catalog entry from a different year's product line is a SERIES-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other engine in the same factory, an INSTRUMENT-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Í annarri lotu sama móts náði keppinautaliðið samtals {D}pts.
items.gloss_en: In another round of the same tournament, the opposing team reached a total of {D} pts.
items.entity_note: A rival team's total from a different round of the tournament is a SERIES-type owner, unlike the first sentence's teammate, a PERSON-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Í útibúi bankans í annarri borg var meðalinnstæða viðskiptavina ${D} þennan mánuð.
items.gloss_en: At the bank's branch in another city, the average customer balance was ${D} that month.
items.entity_note: A bank branch in another city is a PLACE-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other client at the same bank, a PERSON-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Í deild klúbbsins í annarri borg náði stigasafn félaga samtals {D}pts þennan mánuð.
items.gloss_en: In the club's chapter in another city, members' combined points reached {D} pts that month.
items.entity_note: The club's chapter in another city is a PLACE-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other member of the same club, a PERSON-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Birgðavörður í aðalstöðvum keðjunnar hélt utan um sérstakan lager sem nam {D}.
items.gloss_en: A stock manager at the chain's headquarters kept a separate inventory amounting to {D}.
items.entity_note: A named employee's personal, separate inventory is a PERSON-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other warehouse in the same chain, a PLACE-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Sjálfstæður söluaðili, sem starfar undir sama vörumerki, var með tekjur upp á ${D} þennan mánuð.
items.gloss_en: An independent retailer operating under the same brand had income of ${D} that month.
items.entity_note: An independently-run franchisee is a PERSON-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other shop in the same chain, a PLACE-type owner.

items.distractor_fact: Besti markaskorari deildarinnar skoraði sjálfur mörk sem námu {D} á tímabilinu.
items.gloss_en: The league's top individual scorer personally scored goals amounting to {D} during the season.
items.entity_note: An individual player's personal tally is a PERSON-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other team in the same league, an organisation-type ENTITY owner.

items.distractor_fact: Stöðvarvörður skráði í eigin dagbók komu annarrar, ótengdrar lestar {D}mín eftir miðnætti, en áætlun hennar var ekki gefin upp.
items.gloss_en: A station attendant recorded in his own logbook the arrival of another, unrelated train at {D} min after midnight, though its schedule was not stated.
items.entity_note: A station employee's personal logbook entry is a PERSON-type owner, unlike the first sentence's other train on a different route, an INSTRUMENT/ENTITY-type owner; per the shared-reference rule, its own schedule is explicitly not given.
